findings.reason: §46 is still `implementable` with open followup f-tmstwiw-046, so the roadmap will dispatch a node to re-investigate a settled question starting from a premise (the prune is ruled out) that §44 explicitly calls wrong, and the Done when lets it close on an open candidate list rather than the cause §44/§47 already name.
findings.text: §46's Why reads "The retention prune in materialize_committed_tree keeps the newest three. So neither the newest tree's removal nor a two-tree directory is its doing, as the plan review of §44 showed. The removal path is unknown", and its Done when still offers closing on "the candidates the evidence leaves open"; but §44 at line 446 says the paragraph ruling the prune out "was wrong" and that "the imas-codex session's follower logged 'removed old reload tree …/752681b41…' at 17:10:12.711Z. That was the retention prune at shutil.rmtree(entry)", and §47 at line 458 opens "§46 traced reckon-cd's 17:10Z deferral to two followers pruning the same reload-tree directory at once" — so §46's own text denies the cause its siblings record it as having found

findings.reason: §44 leaves the grace value unspecified ("a stated grace"), so a node could satisfy every §47 case with a grace shorter than the 137 s churn window §47 exists to survive, shipping the section without the protection it names.
findings.text: §47's Deliverable states "The publish grace from §44 covers at least a measured HEAD-churn window. The first step states the window it uses and why", but neither of the two done-when cases exercises a recently-published tree that ranks old during churn, so the gate cannot show the grace is wide enough

rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §47's deliverable requires §44's publish grace to cover a measured HEAD-churn window, but no done-when case measures that the grace actually covers it.
